name: UI UX Pro Max
use_label: Design sense for AI coding tools
one_liner: A design-knowledge skill that lets AI coding tools pick styles, palettes, fonts and UX rules when they build screens.

text.why: Hand screens to an AI coding tool and you tend to get the same default look. UI UX Pro Max packs UI styles, colour palettes, font pairings, chart types and UX guidelines into a searchable reference the agent draws on for the screen it is building.
text.take: With over 130,000 stars, it is one of the most widely used design skills right now.
build: A skill that plugs into Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Antigravity, GitHub Copilot, Kiro, Codex and Qoder. The official site shows demo screens built across stacks and styles, and the README has a Korean version.

who.role: Developers and solo founders who build web and app screens with AI coding tools.

start.text: Run the install command shown on uupm.cc (uipro init --ai), then ask your AI coding tool to build a screen.

caveat: The repository is MIT, but the official site also sells a separate Premium tier. Results still depend on the AI model you pair it with.

license.scope_text: Use, change and redistribute, commercially too. Keep the notice.

numbers.star_delta_unit: GitHub stars gained in the window, GH Archive events summed to as_of
numbers.method: Star total = the value last checked on GitHub (stars_checked_at) + increases observed via GH Archive since. The 24h · 7d · 30d gains are GH Archive hourly events summed to the reference time (as_of). No score of ours.
